description:
Fetches sets of metrics from the operating system and services

Metricbeat fetches a set of metrics on a predefined interval from the operating system and services such as Apache web server, Redis, and more and ships them to Elasticsearch or Logstash.
## Features and enhancements
- Build the input status report of Beat receivers in time linear in the number of inputs. #53723
- Add the tier_stats metricset to the autoops_es module to collect the number and the duration of the requests of the search and indexing tiers of an Elasticsearch Serverless project. #54117

## Fixes
- Fix quadratic cost of building the receiver config for units with many streams. #53726 #53731
- Update Brotli to 1.2.7 to fix a decoder panic on malformed input. #54234
- Reduce retries and repeated error logs from Beat receivers while the output is unreachable. #54271
- Fix "ApiVersionsRequest V3" errors on Kafka broker connections by updating the Sarama fork. #54546
- Fix process CPU ticks and percentages being under-reported about 40 times on Apple Silicon macOS. #54502
